// diagnostic

E0303

struct/variant construction field errors

What

struct/variant construction field errors

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Correct the named construction fields to match the struct or variant.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0303: tests/ui/named_pattern_unnamed_case.stderr.

Error [jet.InvalidConstructionField]: Case `BadURL` has no field names to match
  --> named_pattern_unnamed_case.jet:9:9
    |
  9 |         .BadURL{reason} -> reason
    |         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Only a case declared with named fields can be matched with `{field: pattern}`; this case's payload is positional
 Fix: Match it by position: `.BadURL(reason)`
